title: Script Progress: impact.json
description: Cumulative contributions for the Impact Summary: one property per measure, each holding its points oldest first. Written by impact() / trackImpact(). Unlike deltas.json, which charts what a value IS now, these points are ADDED UP — so a point is a contribution, not a reading.

additionalProperties.description: Points for one measure, oldest first. The property name is the measure name; formatting comes from scriptProgress.deltaTracker.formats.

impactPoint.description: One run’s contribution to a cumulative measure.

date.description: ISO timestamp of when the contribution was recorded. Used to work out the "this month" figure.

value.description: What this run contributed. Totals are a plain sum of these.

task.description: Name of the task that recorded it.

runId.description: Id of the run, so the card can say how many runs are behind a total.

label.description: Human-readable name for the measure, shown on the card instead of the raw key.
